cards.card_text: Then the storm rolls in: who can understand how the clouds spread out, or how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
cards.verse_text: Furthermore, who can understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
cards.snippet: …understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?

cards.card_text: His THRONE, and he'll spread his royal pavilion over those same stones.
cards.verse_text: Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
cards.snippet: …these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
